errors.text_span: Каждо година е разделена на групирани стълбове
errors.evidence: The bars are stacked, not grouped. The image clearly shows stacked bars for each scenario and year.
The legend does not include 'слънчева енергия' (solar energy). The machine-generated description hallucinates this category.
The legend labels this category as 'Въглища (ТЕЦ)', not 'Въглища (ТЕМ)'.
The y-axis does not specify units (TWh), and the value for coal in 2030 is closer to 35-40 based on the image, not 60.
The description does not explicitly state the chart represents the distribution of energy sources across scenarios and years, as indicated in the atom checklist.
The description omits the y-axis units (not specified in the image, but the description incorrectly assumes TWh).
The description fails to mention the 'Съхранение' (Storage) category, which is present in the legend and visible in the stacked bars.
The description does not explicitly mention the 'Геотермални' (Geothermal) category, though it is listed in the legend.
The y-axis units are not specified in the image or legend, so assuming TWh is a hallucination.
The description introduces an interpretation of dominance that is not explicitly supported by the image for all years (e.g., coal decreases significantly by 2050).
